test_case.purpose: Validate every approved 1DPC DIMM for 12 hours at measured low rails without training, ECC/RAS, SST or stability failure.
test_case.test_command: Operator installs the approved population under ESD, verifies training/SMBIOS/EDAC, ramps to 40C/-5%, runs pinned all-memory SST for 12 hours with allocation/channel/ECC/RAS/thermal/heartbeat evidence, then restores nominal environment/reference population and health.
test_case.expected_result: All expected DIMMs train/remain visible and receive approved coverage for the full interval with no disallowed errors or instability; restoration succeeds.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires slot-level identity/training, full allocation/duration, low-rail trace and controller-level oracle. Capacity alone, fewer channels, +5% evidence or short stress cannot pass.
safety_gate: Approved population and calibrated low-rail ramp
Preserve evidence; restore nominal/reference; no retry
test_case.recovery: Stop on memory/environment fault, preserve topology/error evidence, ramp to nominal, restore hardware under ESD if approved, verify inventory/health and do not automatically rerun.
